Title: Template-pack materialization
Purpose: Materialize the full file-driven process-template pack into the repository so the loader, exporter, projection service, tests, and build outputs all have a real on-disk source of truth.
Deliverables: output/process-template-pack/ with the complete shared/local resource tree
toolbox role/step seeds and chrome-actions sidecar
seed-catalog baseline scenarios and framework source records
ReviewQuestions: Are the actual process templates present under repository folders, not only described in workbook rows?
Are shared and local resource scopes both represented on disk?
Can the process-template pack be inspected by a human without opening code?
CorrectiveOnFailure: Create a corrective materialization subbundle that closes missing folders or sidecars before any architecture work resumes.
